result.reason: The Type II licence substantially reaches the fallback and the Customer Data sentence appropriately preserves Customer ownership. However, deliverables may be designated Type I, and the Type I licence is not expressly perpetual. The fallback requires a perpetual, irrevocable licence covering all deliverables, not only Type II Materials. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve the existing ownership structure, although “sublicense copies” is less precise than sublicensing the relevant licence rights.
